note: Canonical SURFACE MAP — for each surface (product / runtime / open hub / site), its EDGE/WEDGE (the one-line differentiator), buyer, status, AND how it COMMUNICATES with the other surfaces (the inter-surface graph). Consolidates what was scattered across company_portfolio_map.json (company boundaries), brand.json (branding), portfolio_dependency_law.json (import law), and strategy prose. MUST agree with the dependency law: product-layer communication edges follow Baltor->Teleon->OpenHarnessHub, never the reverse (checked by scripts/check_surface_map.py). serves_truth=false for any model-generated surface output.

surfaces.wedge: Parent / holding brand — owns no runtime and no customer data; the PROMISE across the family (Context · Capability · Proof). An umbrella over Baltor (context), Teleon (runtime), and the open ecosystem — NOT a customer-facing product.

Fully MANAGED, governed context — company-wide / department-wide / initiative-wide. Verified, Current, Provable. 'Models don't fail. Their context does.' Ingest -> reconcile -> harden -> enrich -> compress -> serve, with receipts + CDC freshness. Powered by Teleon (runs as a tenant). Governs what becomes TRUE.
surfaces.buyer: companies/teams that want fully MANAGED org-/department-/initiative-wide context (first live wedge = compliance / AML / OFAC sanctions screening)

communicates_with.how: Baltor runs ON Teleon — capability execution, descent, receipts. Direction allowed by the dependency law.
pulls signed authoritative sources (source_authority_registry: OFAC, eCFR, Federal Register) with CDC re-sync

surfaces.wedge: Its OWN product (not just Baltor's runtime): program a capability in PLAIN TEXT and Teleon makes it ADAPT to the most EFFICIENT + BOUNDED form that still meets your guardrails (the descent), receipt-backed. Thin control/metadata/orchestration plane — the final unit + improvement runs execute EXTERNALLY (Cloudflare Workers/Workers AI, the customer's account, the edge) — OR Teleon emits the capability as a GitOps REPO the customer runs in their OWN dev->test->prod CI/CD (compiler emit_repo); either way Teleon tracks results+metadata (the descent brain = the moat). Governs what becomes EFFICIENT (Baltor governs truth). See docs/architecture/teleon-control-plane-vs-compute.md.
surfaces.buyer: people/teams who want to program capabilities in plain text + have them auto-optimize to cheapest-bounded within guardrails; AI agents; engineering teams bleeding on frontier-model cost; + Baltor as a tenant

communicates_with.how: imports the open CapabilityTask spec + evals/harnesses. Direction allowed by the law (never the reverse).
the SELECTION SUBSTRATE — model_index, search_provider_registry, pipeline_step_catalog, capability_implementation_registry — the descent picks the cheapest viable row
executes Baltor's PurposeTasks; returns governed results + receipts
Agent Capability Gateway — receipt-backed CapabilityTasks for external agents

surfaces.wedge: The open STORE + the open CapabilityTask spec (CTS): a shared catalog of reusable components — context, tools, models, steps, DAG components, skills, harnesses, evals, templates — that BOTH Baltor and Teleon consume. The community substrate the commercial layers ride above.
surfaces.buyer: OSS community / contributors / standards adopters; consumed by both Baltor + Teleon

communicates_with.how: base layer — OpenHarnessHub imports neither Baltor nor Teleon (the law's floor). Exports specs + harnesses upward.

surfaces.wedge: The STORE, by category — each OpenHubForAI hub registers reusable components BOTH Baltor and Teleon consume: models, context, compression, skills, tools, benchmarks, receipts, routing + the method components (reconciliation / robustness-hardening / enrichment / optimization / verification RULES) + predefined modules that run on Teleon OR custom compute. Populates Teleon's selection substrate (more/deeper => better descents) AND supplies Baltor's context methods.
surfaces.buyer: consumed by BOTH Baltor (context methods) and Teleon (selection substrate); opened per trigger + owner clearance

communicates_with.how: each hub's rows are a search space for a descent axis (model->cost/specialization, context->freshness, harness->the bar, skill->tokens)

surfaces.wedge: The proof surface — every descent demo with its MEASURED saving vs the expensive default (extraction 47-91%, enrichment 86%), governed (serves_truth=false). Results are EVIDENCE measured WITH OpenHarnessHub harnesses/rubrics (which they cite): OpenHarnessHub owns the proof INSTRUMENTS, teleon-demos owns the RESULTS — neither is a truth authority. Shows the runtime is real, not slideware.

communicates_with.how: computes live savings from the real demo modules (document_extraction_cascade, search_enrich, the DAG pipelines)

surfaces.wedge: The high-fidelity design/brand handoff bundle (24+ surfaces, 22 hubs) for Claude Code Max — the single source for the portfolio's UI.

communicates_with.how: the branded-house UI for the parent + products + hubs (Hanken Grotesk + IBM Plex Mono)

communication_law: Product-layer dependency + runtime calls follow Baltor -> Teleon -> OpenHarnessHub, NEVER the reverse (architecture/portfolio_dependency_law.json). Registries/hubs feed Teleon's substrate; Baltor ingests signed sources; Teleon serves agents + Baltor. Co-located for latency, contract-separated for clarity, account-separated for security (company_portfolio_map.json).
